name: Audio Manager Pro
headline: Switch your entire audio setup with one key.
description:
Switch your entire Windows audio setup with one key.

Create Audio Profiles for setups like Headset, Speakers, Meeting, Streaming, or VR. One profile can set Windows Default Output, Communications Output, Default Input, and Communications Input together, then restore saved endpoint volume and mute state where supported.

Audio Manager Pro is built for complete setup changes, not per-app mixing. Move from speakers and a desk mic to a headset, switch into a meeting-safe setup, or hand audio over to VR without rebuilding the routing one device at a time.

What's Inside: Apply Audio Profile, Set Output Device, Set Input Device, Cycle Audio Profile, Audio Profile Status, Mute Default Mic, and Profile Output Volume for Stream Deck +.

Audio devices can change identity after USB, Bluetooth, driver, or Windows events. Audio Manager Pro stores stronger Windows device identity where available, safely rebinds when it can, and shows a missing device when it cannot. It never silently picks a different device just because the friendly name looks similar. Applying a profile reports SUCCESS, PARTIAL, or FAILED so incomplete changes stay visible.

On Stream Deck +, rotate the profile output dial to adjust live volume, press to reapply the selected profile, and touch to toggle that output's mute state.

Wave Link users can configure Monitor Mix to follow Windows Default Output. Audio Manager Pro manages Windows audio roles while Elgato's Wave Link plugin remains the right tool for Wave-specific channel and mix routing.

Runs locally on Windows with no cloud account required.

Requires Windows 10 or newer and Stream Deck 7.3 or newer.

Part of the Packrat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Add complete user-created Audio Profiles for four Windows audio roles
- Restore saved endpoint volume and mute state per profile
- Add resilient endpoint rebinding with explicit missing-device states
- Add SUCCESS, PARTIAL, and FAILED profile results
- Add Stream Deck + profile-output volume control
- Reuse the shared PackRat Windows Core Audio implementation
